<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Circle</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    html, body {
      height: 100%;
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 90vmin);
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg id="ae683f770" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="ae683f770-title">
    <title id="ae683f770-title">Black circle</title>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="currentColor"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

I updated `0.html`. It still shows the same black circle, but the page is sturdier now. I haven't opened it in a browser to check.

- **Scrollbars:** The old `width: 100vw` could add a horizontal scrollbar on desktop. I replaced it with a full-height grid that centers the circle, and used `100dvh` so it stays centered on mobile when the browser toolbar shows or hides.
- **Resizing:** The circle used to be fixed at 400px, so it got cut off on small screens. Now it shrinks to `min(400px, 90vmin)` and stays round.
- **Reset:** Added `box-sizing: border-box` and set the SVG to `display: block` to remove the small gap under inline SVGs.
- **Accessibility:** Added `role="img"` and a `<title>` so screen readers describe it as "Black circle."
- **Colour:** The fill now uses `currentColor`, so you can change it by setting `color` in CSS.
- **Tab title:** Changed from the hash `ae683f770` to "Circle". I kept that hash as the SVG `id` in case something refers to it.

"Improve" was open-ended, so tell me if you had something else in mind, like animation, styling or dark mode.
